**Finding: missing (deviation by omission) — Section 9, Warranties**

The agreement's only "Warranties" section is limited to mutual corporate existence, authority, enforceability and no-conflict representations (¶p0056–p0057), plus a Globix-specific acknowledgement (¶p0058). HDI — which designs, develops, implements, operates, maintains, manages and hosts the Site (§§1.1–1.8) — gives **no performance warranty at all**: no workmanlike-manner standard, no conformance to specifications for any period, no compliance-with-law warranty, no malicious-code warranty, and no repair/re-perform/refund remedy. The Company's only protections are the §1.6 go-live termination right and the §5.2 acceptance right, neither of which survives acceptance.

Helpfully, there is also **no warranty disclaimer** anywhere in the document (no "AS IS" language), so the express warranty can be inserted cleanly without carving it out of a disclaimer.

**Redline (validated, ok:true):** new Section 9(c) inserted after ¶p0058 covering (1) professional and workmanlike performance consistent with industry standards, (2) Site conformance to agreed specifications for twelve (12) months following written acceptance under §5.2, (3) compliance with applicable law, and (4) no virus/malicious code — with a remedy of re-performance, repair or replacement at HDI's option and a fee refund if HDI fails to cure within thirty (30) days. A belt-and-braces sentence preserves the warranty against any future disclaimer. Note that §10.7 already lists Section 9 as surviving for two years, so the new warranty inherits survival automatically.

**Negotiation posture:** 90 days' conformance is offered as the fallback in the comment if HDI resists the 12-month period.
